about: The pose of the owner's head while they turned for the Simple scan, from the helper 3.1.4's own debug trace (journal tag omarchy-face-sweep, 2026-11-04, one lap), one sample per second: [yaw, pitch] in degrees relative to the neutral, as the camera sees them, before rule D (3.1.5). Numbers only, no frames; the trace prints nothing else about the face.

recording_big_turn.about: dev/enrol-record.py `guided` recording (2026-11-02), every lit one-face frame with |yaw| of 30 or more, 137 frames: the median of pitch / |yaw| by band. The same file's frames under 30 of yaw are dominated by the person looking up, which is not coupling, and are not used.
